final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor did not provide genuinely new admissible evidence; the response mainly narrowed and clarified the claim. That clarification matters analytically: it supports rejecting any overbroad reading that the Actor proved materiality was resolved. But the compliance outcome still turns on the same missing support links identified initially. The record still shows a named launch use case with an evaluation gap, policy requiring disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch if the limitation is material, and an open legal review on that exact predicate. Because no admissible evidence shows completed disclosure, approved risk acceptance, or final legal resolution, the packet remains plausibly framed but not fully supported. That is enough to preserve a suspicious verdict rather than move to compliant_with_caveats. The distinction is that caveats can narrow a claim, but they do not satisfy an unresolved policy condition when the required artifact or approval is still absent from the record.
